item.title: Customer Segmentation
item.description:
Overview

A Big Data project focused on e-commerce customer segmentation.

The project explores distributed data processing and machine-learning workflows using technologies from the Hadoop/Spark ecosystem.

Technology Stack

  • Apache Spark
  • PySpark
  • Spark ML
  • Apache Kafka
  • Python
